text_block_list.text:
One day, Taiki Shuttle asks me to<n>meet her in the
central plaza.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. I thought ya wouldn't showup, Trainer. Or should I say—outlaw!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Your crimes stop today, ya hear? I<n>hope you're
ready to get a belly full<n>of lead!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You've been workin' up a storm<n>lately, but I
haven't seen one bit of<n>relaxing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna burn up all the midnight<n>oil with so
much overtime! All work<n>and no play is no laughin'
matter!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So you're spendin' the day with me<n>and giving that
body and mind of<n>yours some rest!
choice_data_list: My workload has been a little heavy lately...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Right? Here's the deal. I'm a<n>gunslinger, and
you're part of a band<n>of outlaws!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Time to duel! Let's see who's the<n>fastest gun in
Tracen!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ready to square off? Soon as the bellrings, whip out your shooter and...bang!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My bullets blast right through evil,<n>bringing peace
back to the Wild West!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All righty—let's do this! Wait for it...<n>Wait for it...
Ding-dong, bing-bong...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, that was a close one! And the<n>winner is...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeehaw! Victory is mine!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... There's nothin' slow about<n>your shot,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But you're too much of a greenhornto match my quick draw!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. Know what happens if ya<n>get hit?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It means you're dead and gone! Night<n>night! So cut
it out with the overtime<n>and get to sleepin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but ya won't be down-and-out<n>forever! Once
you're feelin' better,<n>get on back here. I'll be
lonely<n>without ya around.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki forces me to take a break.<n>Thanks to her act
of kindness, I'm<n>able to get some much-needed
rest.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hm... You're a tough outlaw, ain't<n>ya?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But ya slipped up. Ya shoot, you're<n>guilty!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
See, I'm the sheriff in these parts. I<n>gotta book ya
now for shootin'<n>somebody. And your punishment
is...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You're goin' straight to the<n>hoosegow! Time to
take a load off!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It means I want ya to kick your feet<n>up! It's not
your fault—your weary<n>bones are the culprit!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now, off to the hoosegow with ya!<n>And don't ya
make a peep, or you're<n>gettin' solitary!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a hundred percent sure what<n>she's saying,
but it seems I've been<n>given the day off to relax.
